typeName.description: The type name to show documentation for.

fieldName.description: The field name, of the specified type, to show documentation for.

hideInherited.description: Normally, inherited methods are included in the documentation, but they can be suppressed as well.

showDeclaration.description: Normally, type and field declarations (DSL syntax) are hidden in documentation, but they can be shown as well.

showPrivate.description: Normally, private methods are hidden in the documentation, but they can be shown as well.

minIndexFields.description:
The field index menu is only shown if there at least this many fields in the index. (Otherwise, the page is
presumably too short to need an index).

title:
The in-console type documentation. This instantiates the console tab labeled "Types" (with the briefcase icon).
It also creates the global function `c3ShowType` that can be invoked with a type name, and optionally a field name,
in JavaScript.
name: ConsoleShowType
